2608.02270.title: TS-MAMP: A Remanufactured Agricultural Robot Powered by Second-Life EV Components and NMS-Free On-Device Weed Detection
2608.02270.paper_summary: Agriculture 4.0 robotic systems improve field efficiency yet remain too capital-intensive for the fragmented smallholdings that dominate global agriculture. Meanwhile, a growing number of retired low-speed electric-vehicle (LSEV) powertrains retain functional electromechanical value but are destructively recycled. This paper presents TS-MAMP (Telescopic-Sleeve Modular Agricultural Mobile Platform), a remanufactured robot built under 3R (reduce, reuse, recycle) circular-economy principles. Retired 48 V brushless-DC (BLDC) hub motors are paired via back-EMF matching, and lead-acid battery modules screened at 60%-80% state of health are actively balanced within a 100 mV inter-module voltage deviation. Together, these reused components reduce the powertrain-and-chassis BOM cost by approximately 60%, to below USD 450 (perception and weeding modules excluded). The truss chassis provides >=200 kg static load, continuously adjustable track width from 1200 mm to 2000 mm, and <=5-minute module changeover. An NMS-free (non-maximum-suppression-free) YOLOv10n detector with consistent dual-assignment training and negative-sample learning achieves 80.87% mean average precision (mAP)@0.5 (58.41% mAP@0.5:0.95) on the Wanxi Crop-Weed dataset, and is deployed via FP16 TensorRT on a Jetson Nano, confirming on-device inference feasibility. TS-MAMP demonstrates that retired EV components, under modest screening, can be re-engineered into affordable, AI-enabled agricultural robots--opening a remanufacturing pathway for the smallholder fields that commercial automation leaves unserved.
2608.02270.paper_summary_zh: 農業4.0機器人系統提高了田間效率，但對於主導全球農業的分散小農場來說，仍然過於資本密集。與此同時，越來越多的退役低速電動車（LSEV）動力系統保留了功能性電機價值，但卻被破壞性回收。本文介紹了TS-MAMP（伸縮套筒模組農業移動平台），這是一種根據3R（減少、重複使用、回收）循環經濟原則製造的再製造機器人。退役的48 V無刷直流（BLDC）輪轂電動機通過反電動勢匹配進行配對，並且在60%-80%健康狀態的鉛酸電池模塊之間主動平衡，模塊間電壓偏差不超過100 mV。這些重複使用的組件將動力系統和底盤的物料清單成本降低約60%，降至450美元以下（不包括感知和除草模塊）。桁架底盤提供>=200 kg的靜載荷，持續可調的軌道寬度從1200 mm到2000 mm，以及<=5分鐘的模塊更換時間。無最大抑制的YOLOv10n檢測器通過一致的雙重分配訓練和負樣本學習，在Wanxi作物-雜草數據集上達到80.87%的平均精度（mAP）@0.5（58.41% mAP@0.5:0.95），並通過FP16 TensorRT在Jetson Nano上部署，確認了設備端推理的可行性。TS-MAMP證明了在適度篩選下，退役的電動車組件可以重新工程化為可負擔的、具備AI功能的農業機器人——為商業自動化未能服務的小農場開啟了一條再製造的道路。
